obligations.condition: Fresh dedicated email/password signup returns same-account credentials. Bootstrap marker and independent UID lookup establish ownership before private identity persistence. Expiry shape and 3600-second expectation are separate checks.
The signup token retrieves the account with its original marker. Verified UID persistence and readback are harness prerequisites before any displayName mutation.
Set displayName to Fireemu display first using the original signup ID token; response reports the same UID/email and unchanged photoUrl.
Lookup reports the first name and preserves localId, email, photoUrl, emailVerified and disabled.
Replace displayName with Fireemu display second; response reports the same UID/email and unchanged photoUrl.
Lookup reports the second name and preserves selected identity fields.
Attempt displayName Fireemu display refused with the fixed malformed token not-a-valid-id-token. Expect HTTP400 INVALID_ID_TOKEN; not expired-token enforcement or independent signature verification.
After refusal, valid-token lookup preserves localId, email, displayName, emailVerified, disabled, providerUserInfo and photoUrl compared with pre-refusal lookup. Not full-state immutability.

Send deleteAttribute [DISPLAY_NAME] using the original ID token. Expect unchanged UID/email/photoUrl and omitted displayName. Clearing is documented; exact omission is a wire-shape hypothesis for production comparison.
Lookup confirms omitted displayName and selected identity fields unchanged; null and empty strings remain distinct mismatches.
Use the original signup token to delete the dedicated account. Private saved UID/email, not the modified displayName, identify the account for ownership checks.
Exact UID and email Admin lookups find no account. Repeated recovery uses persisted identity to recheck absence; unknown absent signup never counts as cleanup success.

limitations: No human approval. Twelve cases of displayName-only REST behavior after bootstrap, no tenant, strict local artifact and recorded production configuration.
Uses the previously fetched immutable official REST snapshot whose raw/body hashes and fetchedAt are preserved above; selected sections reviewed for this slice on 2026-09-10.
ReturnSecureToken is omitted on profile updates. Update token issuance, refresh, Unicode/length boundaries, null/empty writes and simultaneous set/clear are not checked.
Exact omission is an explicit wire-shape hypothesis; the documentation establishes clearing, not omission versus null.

Private identity persistence is a recorder control, not cryptographic provenance. No displayName value may be mutated until verified UID is saved and read back. Recovery without saved UID still requires bootstrap marker.
No credential change, URL/image operation, provider synchronization, SDK, MFA, Rules, expiry enforcement, independent signature verification or public npm/full Auth claim.
Raw source bytes remain in the private operator cache; raw account responses and reusable credentials are not published.
